job.title: Dental Assistant
job.description:
Please DO NOT apply unless you have at least 6 months practical experience working as a Dental Assistant OR Dental Receptionist AND you are already living in New Zealand (or arriving soon) AND have permission to work here.


ABOUT DENTAL PERSONNEL  
 Dental Personnel is NZ's leading dental temping and employment agency. We also happen to be the friendliest, highest paying, busiest, largest and oldest, having served the New Zealand dental community since 1990.

Our excellent reputation ensures we're the 'preferred supplier' for over 245 dental practices throughout New Zealand who always make us their first call when they need a casual temp or new permanent team member.
 

ABOUT THE ROLES - Temp Dental Assistants &/or Dental Receptionists
Registering to work with Dental Personnel as a temp dental assistant and/or dental receptionist means you become part of the most highly respected and sought after dental temp team in New Zealand. We do everything possible to ensure you are well-supported, and looked after like family.

We provide a very large number of private practices and public dental units  with temporary staff (dental assistants or receptionists) to cover staff absences or shortages.

Our client practices understand temps will likely need some guidance with the many different workplaces, however, the key to a great dental temp is the ability to 'hit the ground running' and quickly integrate with each client's team.
  
So whether you're between jobs, on Uni holidays, or just looking for more work/life balance and flexibility, why not contact us for a confidential chat? Please also remember that you CAN be registered for temp work with more than one agency!

Key responsibilities include:
  • Welcoming patients
  • Providing excellent patient care, including kind and empathetic support with their dental procedure
  • Working chairside with the dentist (or OHT) during dental procedures
  • Undertaking Sterilisation Room responsibilities and ensuring infection control protocols are always followed
  • Reception duties (if required), answering phones, processing bookings, completing patient callbacks, taking and processing payments etc. 

BENEFITS 
  • Industry best total hourly rates of $26.00 to $33.00 (incl. casual holiday pay) 
  • Complete flexibility of days/hours you wish to work
  • Assistance with fuel and/or parking costs for some assignments  
  • Shifts available across the region, and NZ wide
  • Temp of the Month Award and Bonus 
  • Up to $500 Refer-a-Friend payment
  • Excellent assistance in gaining work in other NZ regions as well as Australia and UK through extensive networks 
  • Free or discounted uniform
  • Work from as little as 1 day a month to full time
  • Opportunities to move from temp to permanent  
  • Pay reviews annually
  • Coaching and support to help securing a permanent role (if/when required)

SKILLS and EXPERIENCE
  • A minimum of 6 months practical experience as a Dental Assistant or Dental Receptionist in New Zealand, Australia, UK, Canada, or USA
  • Skills and experience necessary to provide quality chairside assisting to dental practitioners for all/most common dental procedures
  • Dental qualifications (preferred but not mandatory)
  • Excellent knowledge of Infection Control and Sterilisation protocols
  • Willingness to be available on agreed days and/or on-call
  • Reliable, punctual, and communicative 
  • Positive attitude and friendly personality
  • Ability to work across a variety of different dental practices
  • Experience with EXACT or Titanium Dental software preferred
  • Suitable transport options

HOW TO APPLY
If this sounds like you then we want to hear from you ASAP! Simply click on the 'Apply' button and follow the prompts. Please be sure to include your updated CV (including address and contact details), a brief Cover Letter, and complete any screening questions. We will contact you within a few days if you are shortlisted to join our team.
  
If you would like to learn more about these opportunities, please reach out to Anna on 027 622 6001 for a confidential chat or email her at  info@dentalpersonnel.co.nz
  

THE FINAL WORD
No agency works harder or more passionately for their temps than Dental Personnel. We will always do our absolute best to help our candidates in any way possible, and with 36 years' experience, we almost always can!

Finally, if this opportunity doesn't sound like you but you are working in (or have experience working in) the dental industry, we suggest you reach out to us anyway.  As New Zealand's premier dental recruitment and temp agency, we're confident we help you with free advice, or taking the next step in your dental career ... regardless of what that step is!  It costs nothing and so you have absolutely nothing to lose!

job.title: Dental Assistant
job.description:
Looking for flexibility, variety, and great pay?
We’re on the lookout for experienced Dental Assistants & Dental Receptionists for casual, short and long-term temp roles throughout Wellington.

*  Work when and where you want – complete shift flexibility
*  Earn $26–$33 per hour (incl. casual holiday pay) – the best in the business
*  Be treated like family by NZ’s friendliest and most established dental agency


Who Should Apply?
To be eligible, you must:
  • Already be living in New Zealand (or arriving soon) with work rights
  • Have at least 6 months of practical experience as a Dental Assistant or Dental Receptionist
  • Have worked in New Zealand, Australia, the UK, Canada, or the USA

About Dental Personnel
We’re New Zealand’s oldest, largest and most trusted dental recruitment and temp agency – serving the industry since 1990. With over 245 practices nationwide calling us first when they need cover, we’re proud to provide our temps with the best opportunities, pay, and support in the industry.

Whether you're looking for work during study breaks, between jobs, or seeking long-term flexibility – we’ve got roles to suit your lifestyle.


About the Roles
As a valued member of our temp team, you'll:
  • Welcome patients and provide excellent chairside support
  • Assist dentists, OHTs, or specialists with procedures
  • Manage sterilisation and infection control duties
  • Support front office duties (if required), including bookings, payments & patient care

Why Join Our Team?
  • Top hourly rates: $26–$33 (incl. casual holiday pay)
  • Fully flexible work – pick your days/hours
  • Shifts across the greater Wellington Region & NZ-wide
  • Fuel/parking contributions for selected assignments
  • Annual pay reviews + uniform perks
  • Ongoing coaching + help securing permanent roles (if desired)
  • Opportunities to work in Australia or the UK through our global network

You’ll Need
  • 6+ months' experience in a dental/chairside assistant or front desk role
  • Strong knowledge of infection control and sterilisation
  • Good communication skills and a professional appearance
  • Flexibility and a positive, reliable attitude
  • Experience with EXACT or Titanium software (preferred)
  • Your own reliable transport

Ready to Apply?

Click ‘Apply’ now and include:
  • Your updated CV (with address and contact details)
  • A short cover letter
  • Answers to screening questions
Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within a few days.


Have Questions First?
Call Anna on 027 622 6001 or email: info@dentalpersonnel.co.nz for a friendly, confidential chat.


Final Word
No one works harder – or cares more – for their temps than Dental Personnel. With 35 years of experience, we’re here to support your dental career in every way possible.

Even if this role isn’t quite right, if you have dental experience, reach out anyway – advice is free, and there’s nothing to lose!
